description: Returns one published product by name, ID or page address, or asks which match is meant. The compact answer includes the label composition, applicable reference limits, recent published prices and recorded dates where available. Use detail "full" for the country status, label verification and detailed comparisons, with age, scope and separate references for other countries. Reference data only: it does not cover medication interactions, diagnosis or treatment decisions.

country.description: The United States is the only market currently available.

detail.description: Compact answer by default. Use full for the complete published record.

id.description: Verateca product id, e.g. "US:302778", as returned by search_products.

period_days.description: Optional days of consumption, calculated from verified pack and daily-use basis. This is not a whole-pack checkout price.

product.description: Name on the label, with brand, strength and form where known.

url.description: Verateca product page address, as an alternative to id.

name: get_product
title: Get product
